title: RoutePlannerInput
description: Pure data input contract for deterministic shared-core route planning.

task.description: Task descriptor for provider task matching: the kind plus the requirements routing can check against declared capabilities. Absent requirement fields are never checked, so a text request carries the kind alone.

kind.description: The task kind, matched against the providers' task capabilities.

inputs.description: Input media kinds the request carries. Every one must be accepted by the provider's task capability. The SDKs send ['text'] for text_to_text.

delivery.title: DeliveryRequirement
delivery.description: The output delivery the request requires. Absent for text, whose delivery is implicitly inline.

mediaTypes.description: Acceptable media types; the provider must declare at least one for the requested delivery. Absent means any.

locale.title: LocaleRequirement
locale.description: The locale the request requires. Under 'language' matching the region is a preference: a provider known to offer the exact tag ranks ahead of an otherwise equal one. A provider that cannot enumerate its locales is not rejected on this basis; it must fail before committing instead.

match.title: LocaleMatch
match.description: 'exact' requires the full tag; 'language' requires only the primary language subtag and treats the region as a preference.

voice.title: VoiceRequirement
voice.description: Voice traits the request asks for. Only a 'required' voice can reject a provider; a 'preferred' one shapes which listed voice the plan binds a candidate to, always within the request's privacy policy.

requirement.title: RequirementLevel
requirement.description: 'required' takes part in routing; 'preferred' does not.

interactionMode.description: Interaction mode the caller is requesting. Absent means 'run' (Mode 1), so planner inputs produced before this field existed keep their exact Mode-1 semantics. The mode filters eligible providers; it never changes candidate ordering.

constraints.description: Hard routing constraints evaluated before provider selection.

privacy.description: Privacy requirement or preference for execution placement.

networkOnline.description: Current connectivity snapshot used for cloud route planning.

preferences.description: Soft route ordering preferences applied after hard filtering.

optimizeFor.description: Primary optimization goal when multiple providers remain eligible.

modelProfile.description: The resolved model profile the request routes within. Absent means the built-in 'auto' profile: no allow-list, and ordering by placement and preference alone. When present, providers whose id is not in targetIds are rejected with 'not_in_model_profile', and the position in targetIds ranks the survivors after placement and before preferences. Ids that name no registered provider are ignored.

providers.description: Static descriptors plus dynamic capability checks for planning. Both shapes are the provider schemas themselves, shared by $ref, so the planner reads exactly what checkCapabilities() reports.

capabilities.description: The provider's live capability check, already folded by the engine (for example, streamingAvailable is false when the provider declares streaming but does not implement it).
